records.part: Electrical Switchgear for Solar Photovoltaic Project
records.reason: Procurement of the Switchgear has been identified as the critical path of the Solar project’s schedule.

records.part: Design and construction of Solar Photovoltaic Project and Energy-Related Upgrades at the Wastewater Treatment Facility
records.reason: Engie has also completed numerous energy-related projects throughout the Central Valley amounting to $300M in energy projects including the Solar Facility currently in operation at the City’s WTTF.
The proposed project is comprised a 845kW fixed solar photovoltaic facility and both energy and operational upgrades to the WTTF.
Upgrades include adding a new 4MGD Oxidation Ditch, Retrofit and Increase Capacity to the existing Oxidation Ditch, and a new 85-foot diameter Secondary Clarifier.
